prompt: Many people now decide where to go on holiday because of photographs and videos they have seen on social media. Do you think this is a positive or a negative development?
essay:
Nowadays, social media is playing a big role in the life of the people, and many people are choosing their holiday place after seeing the photos and videos on Instagram or other apps. In my opinion, this is more a negative development than a positive one, although it has some good sides also.

Firstly, there are some positive points. Social media gives people a lot of information about the places for free. Before, people had to buy the guide book or ask to the travel agent, but now they can see the real pictures of the hotel, the beach and the food before they go. Moreover, small places which were not famous before can become popular, so the local people can earn more money from the tourists.

However, the negative points are more important. Firstly, many photos on social media are not real, because people are using the filters and editing, so when the tourists reach the place they feel disappointed. Secondly, when one place become famous online, thousands of people go there at the same time and it become very crowded and dirty. For example, some beautiful villages are now full of tourists who only want to take the selfie and then leave. Moreover, some people are doing dangerous things like standing on the edge of the cliff only for getting a good photo, and some of them have accident.

In conclusion, although social media is useful and can help the small places, I think it is a negative development because the photos are often fake, the places become overcrowded and people take the risks. People should use social media carefully and also check other informations before they choose the destination.
title: Choosing holidays from social media photos
